brief.headline: Push for ₹66.48/KG (Sayaji's price) and qualify a second source — they hold 56% of our Dextrose spend with no backup.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹66.48/KG, matching the best price we already pay to Sayaji Industries Limited.
priceAsk.basis: We currently pay them ₹68.45/KG — 3.0% more than Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG for the same material. The market ask for Anhydrous Dextrose IP sits at ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48/KG is market-fair and proven inside our own network.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — it already frees up ₹1.74 Cr for us compared to paying on delivery.

brief.financialLeverage: Gujarat Ambuja publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or cash position. Our ₹21.21 Cr spend represents 56% of our Dextrose buy — a big chunk, but we don't know how large we are to them. Without their numbers, our leverage comes from two places: the ₹1.26 Cr gap to Sayaji's proven price, and the fact that we have no backup — which means they know we need them, but also means we must line up a second source to balance the power in future rounds.

evidence.point: We pay them 3.0% more than our cheapest supplier for Dextrose
Closing that gap saves us ₹1.26 Cr every year
evidence.figure: ₹1.26 Cr annual excess vs best price we pay

evidence.point: They supply over half our Dextrose, with no approved backup
Market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP run ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our target sits in the middle
India export unit value for Dextrose is 42.95 ₹/kg — well below what we pay, showing room to move

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller that makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; a lead to qualify (verify IP monograph CoA before switching).

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, established dextrose/sorbitol supplier — drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji; a lead to qualify.

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global starch major Roquette, pharma-grade dextrose/excipients, premium and very reliable (₹2898.05 Cr revenue, health D 28/100); a lead to qualify.

risks: They hold 56% of our Dextrose volume (₹21.21 Cr) with no qualified backup — pushing too hard without a second source lined up could leave us stuck if they walk.
Their financials aren't public, so we can't gauge how much they need our business or whether cash is tight — tailor the pressure to their reactions in the room.
The ₹66.48/KG target is proven at Sayaji but assumes similar specs and logistics — confirm lead-time, packaging and CoA match before you lock the price.
Qualifying one of the alternates (Tirupati, Gulshan, Roquette India) will take time — start the RFQ process now so you have real leverage in the next negotiation round.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to close the 3.0% gap between your ₹68.45/KG and the ₹66.48/KG we already pay Sayaji — and we're also qualifying a second Dextrose source to spread our volume more evenly.
